trust.title: Trust & Data Governance
trust.subtitle: How Trafiqo keeps your data private and keeps cities in control
trust.privacyFirstDesc: We collect only what you explicitly share. No background tracking, no passive location harvesting.
trust.humanOversightDesc: All decisions affecting individuals remain with human city operators. Trafiqo never acts autonomously.
trust.noSurveillanceDesc: Trafiqo does not build individual profiles. Cities see aggregated, anonymised data only.
trust.transparencyDesc: Our algorithms, data flows and governance documents are available to city partners on request.
trust.a1: Trafiqo collects only the data you explicitly choose to share — your selected travel mode and voluntary check-ins. No background tracking, no passive location harvesting.
trust.a2: Your individual data is never shared with third parties. Cities and transport authorities only see aggregated, anonymised statistics — never individual journeys.
trust.a3: Yes. You can request full deletion of your account and all associated data at any time from your profile page. Deletion is irreversible and takes effect within 72 hours.
trust.a4: Yes. Trafiqo is designed from the ground up to comply with GDPR and Hungarian data protection law. Data processor agreements, retention schedules and DPIAs are available on request.
trust.q5: Does Trafiqo use AI to make decisions about me?
trust.a5: No autonomous decisions are made about individuals. The behavioural model produces aggregate forecasts — all individual-level decisions remain with human city operators.
trust.a6: The behavioural model is a synthetic traffic simulation trained on aggregated, anonymised historical flow data. It predicts how congestion patterns may evolve — it does not track individuals.
trust.commitment1: Data minimisation: we collect only what is necessary
trust.commitment2: Purpose limitation: data is used solely for urban mobility insights
trust.commitment3: Storage limitation: data is retained no longer than necessary
trust.commitment4: Cities retain full control and can withdraw at any time
trust.modelBadge: Behavioural model — not measured individual data
